transcript: The rain had stopped by the time Clara reached the old lighthouse. She paused at the door, listening to the waves breaking somewhere below, and for a moment she wondered whether coming back had been a mistake.

Keď Jana vystúpila z vlaku, mesto ešte spalo. Nad strechami vysela rietka, hmla a z pekárne na rohu vonal čerstvý chlieb. Zastala pri starej lipe, kde sa kedysi stretávala s otcom a chvíľu len počúvala, ako sa ulica pomaly prebúdza.
